summary: Executed focused media-delivery verification for Pirone tutorial endpoints: all backend HTTP integrity/range/headers tests passed; full local AV decode and timeline/subtitle structural checks passed. Browser automation could not complete seek playback due headless media limitation/timeouts.

integration_issues.issue: Automation browser could not reliably load metadata/seek on direct MP4 endpoint (metadata timeout; request aborted in automation logs). This appears to be tool/headless codec or media-pipeline limitation, not backend delivery integrity.

action_items: Run non-headless real-browser playback validation for required seek checkpoints and screenshot capture (Safari/Chrome desktop/device) to close the last UI playback evidence gap.
Keep current media endpoint/helper implementation unchanged; backend media delivery checks are passing across GET/HEAD/Range/If-Range/multi-range-ignore paths.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking backend code defects found in /api/manual/aitour-guida-pirone media helper path during this run; range and conditional delivery behavior matched expected contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three automation playback attempts hit metadata timeout/context deadline on direct MP4 playback, while endpoint bytes/hash/range and local ffmpeg full decode all pass. Prioritize real non-headless browser media playback validation only.
rca_of_issue: RCA (playback evidence gap): In automation environment, direct MP4 route renders player UI but loadedmetadata did not fire reliably and one run logged net::ERR_ABORTED for video request. Since backend byte-range tests pass and full file decodes cleanly with imageio_ffmpeg (H264/AAC, 1080p25, duration 1576.36), most likely cause is browser-tool/headless media pipeline limitation rather than file corruption.
